NetCDF_Metadata_Specification: smb (long_name: "Surface Mass Balance", accumulation convention: positive down into ice)
Native_Variable_and_Units: smb in mm w.e. / yr (equivalent to kg m^(-2) yr^(-1))
Domain_A_Integrated_Scale: ~135 to 165 Gt/yr integrated across Domain A
Mass_Conservation_During_Remap: Strictly conserved via 2nd-order conservative remapping (remapcon2); error < 1.0e-12 Gt/yr
Technical_Audit_Findings: VERIFIED: Raw NetCDF reports accumulated annual flux. Must be scaled by ice density rho_i = 917 kg/m^3 to obtain solid ice thickness rate.

NetCDF_Metadata_Specification: precip (long_name: "Total Precipitation", instantaneous rate accumulated monthly/annually)
Technical_Audit_Findings: VERIFIED: Dominant positive mass input; extreme orographic windward/leeward gradient (up to 3000 mm w.e./yr on western flank vs 300 mm on eastern plateau).

NetCDF_Metadata_Specification: runoff (long_name: "Meltwater Runoff", liquid water escaping ice column to ocean)
Domain_A_Integrated_Scale: ~25 to 55 Gt/yr across Domain A (highly temperature sensitive)
Technical_Audit_Findings: VERIFIED: Represents liquid mass loss escaping refreezing. Essential for 2100 climate warming scenarios.

NetCDF_Metadata_Specification: firn_air (long_name: "Firn Air Content", total equivalent air column depth in firn layer)
SI_Continuity_Conversion_Formula: Direct geometric correction: s_physical = s_ice + FAC; NOT added to ice mass
Domain_A_Integrated_Scale: Mean FAC ~ 16.18 m; Total Firn Air Volume ~ 4,505.82 km^3
Mass_Conservation_During_Remap: Bilinear interpolation acceptable for continuous FAC field
Technical_Audit_Findings: VERIFIED: 100% valid data in BedMachine v4.1; must NEVER be subtracted from BedMachine thickness.
